about: Office for National Statistics (ons.gov.uk), the UK's official statistics site. This CLI searches publications and data, reads time series values and metadata, bulletins, datasets and the release calendar, and downloads CSV data. It is read-only and needs no login.

commands.summary: Site-wide keyword search over ONS publications, bulletins, time series and datasets, with content-type and census topic filters, sorting and paging

params.name: filter
params.description: Content type filter. Examples: publications, bulletin, time_series, datasets, user_requested_data. The UI repeats this param when several are chosen.

commands.summary: Search the time series explorer (58k+ series) by keyword and/or topic path; each result shows the series ID (CDID) and dataset ID

params.name: topic
params.description: Restrict to a topic's time series, e.g. /economy/inflationandpriceindices/timeseries

commands.summary: Get time series metadata and its latest value (title, CDID, unit, latest period and value, release dates, source dataset) from the ONS content API

params.name: topic
params.description: Topic path without leading/trailing slash, e.g. economy/inflationandpriceindices or employmentandlabourmarket/peoplenotinwork/unemployment. Take it from a search-timeseries result URL.

params.name: series_id
params.description: Series ID (CDID), lowercase, e.g. l55o, d7g7, mgsx

params.name: dataset
params.description: Source dataset ID, lowercase, e.g. mm23, lms

commands.summary: Get the monthly observations of a time series as a list of {date, value} (for quarterly or annual-only series use download-timeseries-csv)

params.name: topic
params.description: Topic path without leading/trailing slash, e.g. economy/inflationandpriceindices

commands.summary: Download a time series as CSV with all frequencies (annual, quarterly, monthly) plus metadata rows; also works for a previous version

params.name: uri
params.description: Time series URI path, e.g. /economy/inflationandpriceindices/timeseries/l55o/mm23. Append /previous/vN for a superseded version.

commands.summary: List previous (superseded) versions of a time series with update date, label/reason and version uri (pass uri to download-timeseries-csv)
Get a statistical bulletin edition: title, summary, release and next-release dates, and its sections

params.name: edition
params.description: Edition slug, e.g. august2026 (take it from list-bulletin-releases)

commands.summary: List all past editions of a bulletin series, newest first
List the datasets and data related to a bulletin edition
Get a dataset page: title, description, release info, any correction notice and the current edition's file download link
List all published data (time series, datasets, user-requested data) for a topic, with keyword filter, sorting and paging
List all publications (bulletins, articles and so on) for a topic, with keyword filter, sorting and paging
List a topic page's headline (spotlight) time series uris, e.g. CPIH/CPI/RPI for inflation
List the release calendar (published, upcoming or cancelled releases) with keyword search, sorting and paging, read from the RSS feed

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Get a release calendar entry: title, release date and time, publication status and summary

params.name: slug
params.description: Release slug, i.e. the last path segment of a release calendar link
